lines.zh: 金发竖起，我踩着碎石走。
lines.en: Gold hair upright, I walk over loose stone.
Fine currents of ki sweep under my feet.

lines.zh: 大魔界的路，我一步一步量。
lines.en: I measure the Demon Realm one step at a time.

lines.zh: 我走路很轻，落地却很沉。
lines.en: My steps are light but land heavy.
Blue eyes now; I can see a long way.
My muscles pull taut under the cloth.
I follow the river valley down.
The wind comes, but my hair doesn't move.
I crack a thin slab underfoot.

lines.zh: 这个形态，力气翻了好几倍。
lines.en: This form multiplies my strength.

lines.zh: 我绕开村子，不想惊动人。
lines.en: I skirt the village so no one's startled.

lines.zh: 一步之后，我已经在坡上。
lines.en: One step later I'm on the slope.
I stand as my aura turns slowly.
My gold hair shines in the light.
My knuckles crack, one by one.

lines.zh: 我在感觉这个世界的重力。
lines.en: I'm feeling this world's gravity.
My aura is pulled in, but not all the way.
This form is still holding.
Blue eyes see things more sharply.
I exhale and let my shoulders drop.
Three ki signatures nearby, all moving.
I close my eyes and listen a while.

lines.zh: 衣服被气流吹得贴住背。
lines.en: The aura presses my clothes to my back.
I don't like waiting too long.
The grass at my feet lies flat.
I shift weight to the other foot.
Your ki isn't strong, but not weak either.
I look straight at you with blue eyes.
You breathe before you speak.
I can see you're weighing something.
Don't put your hands behind your back.
I step forward and you tense.
At this range, I'd rather not fight.

lines.zh: 你身上有灰尘，走了不少路。
lines.en: You're dusty; you've walked far.

lines.zh: 你的声音我听得很清楚。
lines.en: I hear your voice very clearly.

lines.zh: 我抬头，把下巴抬了一点。
lines.en: I lift my chin slightly.
Have we fought? I don't think so.
If you want to fight, I won't stop you.
My hair covers one eye.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我的脚边。
lines.en: Your shadow falls at my feet.
I didn't come here to kill.

lines.zh: 我笑了一下，收了一点气。
lines.en: I grin and draw my aura in.
Take a step back and I won't advance.
You see the gold hair well enough.

lines.zh: 我吸了口气，金发晃了晃。
lines.en: I gasp; my gold hair sways.
It hurts, but I can still move.
I shake the numbness out of my hand.
Fine, now I'm serious.
Ki steams off the wound.
Your fist is harder than expected.
A wound like this heals fast.
This scratch isn't even a warm-up.
Smell of food; my stomach agrees first.
Give me a bowl and I'll eat slowly.
This smell reminds me of home.
I crouch to your eye level.
Eat first, then business.
That piece in your hand: any more?
I can tell it's been roasted.
I'm not in a rush, but I won't be shy.
I don't transform while eating.

lines.zh: 你撞在我胸口，退了两步。
lines.en: You hit my chest and fall back two steps.
I put a hand out to steady you.
I hadn't fully drawn my aura in; sorry.

lines.zh: 我们撞了一下，地面有印。
lines.en: We collide and leave a mark on the ground.
I turn to give you half the path.
Your shoulder's solid enough.
Don't come too close; the aura burns.
Steady, don't fall back.
This much impact is nothing.
The one at home is always on my mind.
I promised her I'd come back.

lines.zh: 她的气，我隔着山也找得到。
lines.en: I could find her ki across a mountain.
She wouldn't like this form.
I put a hand over my heart.
The food will go cold; I should hurry.
I promised her less trouble.
When she's angry, I don't talk back.
Gold hair glows at night.

lines.zh: 我往家的方向看了一眼。
lines.en: I glance toward home.
I pick up what's on the ground.
This stone has some weight.
Yours, I think; here.
I hold it out to you.
Doesn't look edible; I'll hold it.
I bend down and the aura parts the grass.
Something small is shining.
I know this one: a senzu bean.
It dropped, so I picked it up.
I see where you are.
Your ki just grew heavier.
My hair rises another inch.

lines.zh: 你的招式我大概能猜到。
lines.en: I can guess your moves roughly.
I drop my stance low.
Ki is already in my fist.

lines.zh: 我热身完了，别指望我留情。
lines.en: I am warmed up; do not expect mercy.
You turn; I follow.
A small ki blast first, to test.

lines.zh: 你的气乱了，我听得出来。
lines.en: Your ki is ragged; I can tell.
At this range, one step suffices.
I'm coming in.
The Kamehameha is already formed.
I won't miss this time.
You're not slow.
A ki blast curves around the side.
I know where you'll land.
Afterimage fist; you miss.
You're circling; I won't play.
In the air I can catch you.
Your breathing gets rougher.
I press ki into my soles.
One step clears the whole ditch.

lines.zh: 你已经没多少地方跑了。
lines.en: You're running out of ground.
The meteor combination is coming.
My landing craters get deeper.
You've looked back once.
Right at this corner.
A flash, and I'm closer.
No escape — your ki is locked.
Hah, Kamehameha!
Small ki blasts, one after another.

lines.zh: 我一拳打在你的护臂上。
lines.en: My fist lands on your bracer.
A charged rush, straight through.
An aerial combination; you won't land.
My kick finds your knee.
Ki blasts press in one after another.
I used half strength here.
The blast bursts at your feet.
I push you back.
A turn of the wrist changes the angle.
Your guard is falling apart.
Then let's go again.
You can still stand; good.
The last blow, I pulled it.
It's done; you lost.

lines.zh: 金光散去，我站在那儿了。
lines.en: The golden light fades, and there I stand.

lines.zh: 金发先露出来，然后是我。
lines.en: The gold hair shows first, then me.
My aura pushes the stones aside.
I land; the crater is neither deep nor shallow.

lines.zh: 大魔界的门在我身后关。
lines.en: The Demon Realm gate shuts behind me.
Who called me out?
I look up at the clouds.
I shake my hand and pull the aura in.
The wind bends around me.

lines.zh: 这里连重力都轻得奇怪。
lines.en: Even the gravity here feels strangely light.
I hear birds calling far off.
This power has barely warmed up.

lines.zh: 我站稳了，四下扫了一眼。
lines.en: I settle and scan the horizon.
First, find out where I am.
I raise a hand and the mood settles.
A fight would be fine too.

lines.zh: 火苗卷上衣服，我拍掉了。
lines.en: Flame catches my clothes; I slap it out.
My knees sink on landing.
The water presses in; I push up.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我推得退了一截。
lines.en: The blast shoves me back a length.
An arrowhead lodges in my forearm.

lines.zh: 有股力气锁住我的手脚。
lines.en: Something binds my limbs.

lines.zh: 雷打进身体，我抖了一下。
lines.en: Lightning enters me; I shudder.
Nothing at all but falling.
